items.title: Emerson Electric (NYSE:EMR) posts better-than-expected sales in Q3 CY2026
items.summary: Engineering and automation solutions company Emerson (NYSE:EMR) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026) results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 7.1% year on year to $5.2 billion. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $4.56 billion was less impressive, coming in 0.7% below analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.86 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
